label: nyiso111 ramp envelopes
definition: KEEPER (nyiso-111, 2026-08-02). Single delta on the nyiso-109 keeper: ramp_limits=true arms CAMPD-measured max 1-hour up-move envelopes (77 rows / 48 well-observed NY plants; CC median 0.49x pmax, ST 0.42x, CT 0.92x) so the LP can no longer move a thermal unit faster than the real fleet was ever observed to -- a measured bound, zero free parameters added. On the superseded keeper's own dispatch the envelope was crossed by 0.96/1.26/0.75 % of group-transitions carrying 225,117/291,437/274,134 MWh/yr of infeasible ramping; arming it cuts that to 3,888/4,717/7,062 MWh (-98.27/-98.38/-97.42 %, against a pre-registered floor of 70 %), with the price effect near-inert by design (a correctness bound, not a price lever) -- C3a stays in band and C3c is bit-unchanged (3/0/7 h vs actual 10/12/42 h). Determination stays CALIBRATED-WITH-CAVEATS, C3c the sole ledgered caveat, C1 14/14 all-class and 10/10 free-class.
